title: Register the focused first-seam contract in full Player CI
purpose: Correct a pre-implementation evidence gap by authorizing adversarial QA to register its new focused storage-boundary contract in the existing full Player CI registry, without changing implementation scope or product behavior.
invariants: This correction changes design and governance records only; no player source, test or registry file changes in this pull request.
The developer implementation paths accepted by ARC-WP-010 remain unchanged.
The only new future QA write path is apps/player/dev/checks_registry.json, solely to add tests/contract_storage_boundary.py to the mandatory list.
The registry RC, policy, build command, browser list, existing mandatory entries and report paths remain unchanged.
The focused contract remains authored in apps/player/tests/contract_storage_boundary.py and implementation files remain forbidden to QA.
The Remote Agent profile remains player-full so the new focused test and every existing mandatory and browser check execute through the ordinary release path.
No storage key, data shape, identifier, technology, UI or behavior change is authorized.
requiredEvidence: inspection of apps/player/dev/run_all_checks.py showing full checks are registry-driven
inspection of apps/player/dev/checks_registry.json showing the focused test is not currently registered
Repository governance and PR scope passes on the exact amendment head
adversarialTests: verify only one new mandatory registry entry is authorized
verify no existing mandatory or browser test may be removed or reordered to hide a failure
verify QA registry ownership does not permit edits to build scripts, release configuration or workflows
verify developer implementation paths remain unchanged
verify Stage C remains unaccepted and Stage D remains blocked
nonGoals: write or register any test other than the focused storage-boundary contract
change the test runner, registry schema, release policy or browser suite
change player runtime, product behavior or storage

result.authorizedQaRegistryChange: add tests/contract_storage_boundary.py to mandatory checks only

rollback: Revert this design amendment. No player file, test registry, artifact or learner data is changed by the amendment itself.
